notes.title: SUMMER UPDATE
notes.content: [h3]Status Update[/h3][p] [/p][p]First of all thank you for the people which have attended to the Early Access stage.[/p][p]This EA has considerably boosted and hastened the development process and will certainly iron out all remaining glitches and necessary UX improvement.[/p][p]After all these daily updates since end of June, the game has stabilized, the team will take a bit of vacation for now. [/p][p] [/p][h3]Card Challenge[/h3][p] [/p][p]Cards are not yet set in stone and actually open to player feedback.[/p][p]Some cards may be less useful, some could be improved or you may have ideas of new cards.[/p][p]Even the flavor text may be enhanced.[/p][p] [/p][p]Provide any nice idea of card text and effects in a review in Steam.[/p][p]We will study any proposal, depending on[/p][list][*][p]the review's mood,[/p][/*][*][p]historical accuracy,[/p][/*][*][p]mechanism,[/p][/*][*][p]ease of implementation for the player or AI.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]AI Report[/h3][p] [/p][p][b][i]No Retreat![/i][/b] Experts needed here.[/p][p]The developer would need some nice cases to improve AI behaviour.  If you believe AI could have done really much better in a given turn, just F10 and say what you would have done.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy your summer in the steppe ![/p]
